### Problem statement

Modern healthcare systems impose an enormous administrative and cognitive burden on physicians. Doctors spend more time fighting clunky EMR interfaces, manually parsing unstructured lab reports, and writing repetitive documentation than providing direct patient care. Critical insights trapped inside X-rays, lab PDFs, and patient histories often go unnoticed because no single tool connects them intelligently. In fast-paced urban hospitals, this inefficiency translates directly to physician burnout, diagnostic delay, and compromised patient outcomes.

1. Introduction
In critical domains like mathematics, science, and coding, an AI model's answer is only as valuable as the logic behind it. Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from the "Black Box" problem—delivering conclusions without revealing the steps taken to reach them. This opacity reduces trust and makes error detection nearly impossible.
